title: Clarifying questions that matter
summary: Which opening questions change the design.

choices.text: How many daily active users and videos are there, and how many requests per second at peak?
What should we optimise: clicks, watch time, or long-term retention?
What is the latency budget for the home page?
Which deep learning framework does the team use?
How fresh must recommendations be: should a video uploaded an hour ago be recommendable?
What colour scheme does the home page use?
